## B-700-1 — replacing addresses does not make arbitrary error text safe

**File:line:** `src/observability/log-pii.ts:33-35`; `src/email/email.service.ts:182-188,231-240`; `src/notifications/digest.service.ts:166-168,227-229,451,478,503`; same new boundary at `src/storefront/checkout-recovery.service.ts:278-281`. [New helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src%2Fobservability%2Flog-pii.ts), [email consumers](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src%2Femail%2Femail.service.ts), [digest consumers](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src%2Fnotifications%2Fdigest.service.ts), [recovery consumer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src%2Fstorefront%2Fcheckout-recovery.service.ts)

**Counterexample/proof:** a synthetic Resend 422 body containing `Invalid recipient Patricia Quill <patricia.quill@example.test>; private consultation details` loses the address but preserves the person's name and the private text in the emitted email log, `EmailSendLog.error` and `SendEmailResult.error`; DigestService also logs/stores the name/text, and a render exception retains them in its stored/returned error. Three independent assertions fail on these surfaces while the original privacy guard passes. [Executed exact-head probe 37218198321](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218198321)

**Minimal fix rule:** normalize provider/exception failures to server-owned diagnostic codes, stage, provider/HTTP status and opaque correlation IDs before logging, storing or returning them; do not preserve arbitrary body/message text through an email-only regex. Apply that rule at every new helper consumer and add name/free-text controls for provider, render and digest/checkout failures without changing send/idempotency behavior. [Affected helper consumers](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/compare/b644198b90bb9ab1dc62a78794e12cf09f8ace7c...66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b)

## B-700-2 — webhook “shape” still publishes attacker-controlled names

**File:line:** `src/scheduling/scheduling-webhook.controller.ts:95-108`, used by both handlers at `:60-61,84-85`; character/length regexes are not finite provider event/key allowlists. [Webhook source](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src%2Fscheduling%2Fscheduling-webhook.controller.ts)

**Counterexample/proof:** with the optional secret absent, both public stubs accept `{ event: "Patricia-Quill", "Patricia-Quill": { ... } }` and log `event=Patricia-Quill keys=event,Patricia-Quill`; both no-name assertions fail. This is a leak through the replacement logging implementation, not a request to implement the separate webhook integrations. [Executed probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218198321)

**Minimal fix rule:** log only finite, server-owned recognized event/key labels; map unknown event/key strings to a fixed label or numeric count without logging their contents, preserving the current no-op acknowledgment behavior. Re-run both public-handler probes and a recognized-event control. [Affected logging boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src%2Fscheduling%2Fscheduling-webhook.controller.ts)

**File:line:** `src/admin/federation/finance-admin.client.ts:89-95,165-167`; on a degraded `setCoachPracticeByEmail("pat@example.test", ...)`, the path log includes `/by-email/pat%40example.test/practice`, which remains personal data despite having no `@`. [Existing federation client](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/src/admin/federation/finance-admin.client.ts)

**Fix rule:** operator tickets a separate finite-route-label/opaque-ID logging fix with an encoded-address regression; do not expand this frozen PR for the outside-diff C. The new identifier-pattern guard is useful but is not proof that all `src/` logs are PII-free. [Guard limitations](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/66569a616fed254e2d5022bbc277013e4652788b/test%2Fprivacy%2Fno-pii-in-logs.spec.ts)

  - Earlier runs https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218594635 and https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218955317 gave the same result.
- **Fix rule:**
  1. Drop the name from those 4 lines: log `brief_mode`/date, or pass the coach id into `callClaude` and log `coach=<id>`.
  2. Widen the guard's name rule to any identifier that *contains* a person-name token, e.g. `/(?:first|last|full|display|guest|user|recipient|coach|client|sender)_?name/i` inside the token. Allow-list `err.name`, `constructor.name`, and provider, secret and model names.
  3. Add a `coach=${safeCoachName}` call to the guard's `bad` list.
- **Verify:** the probe spec passes, and the guard's self-test flags the new bad case.

## B-700-2: email addresses still reach log lines through text built from the address
The new README rule says: "Text the service does not write itself (a provider's error body, an exception message) goes through `redactEmailAddresses` first, because providers echo addresses back". The guard says every log call is clean. Two paths prove both claims false at this head, and both are on flows this PR edits.
- **(a) Supabase Auth errors.**
  - `src/auth/auth.service.ts:1474` logs `resetPasswordForEmail failed: ${error.message}`. This is the public forgot-password endpoint, and the caller supplies the address.
  - The same pattern is at `:879` (`generateLink` for `user.email`).
  - Supabase Auth returns `Email address "<address>" is invalid` (`email_address_invalid`; https://github.com/supabase/auth/issues/2252). `resetPasswordForEmail` returns it for blocked or MX-less domains (https://www.guardlayer.io/blog/supabase-email-address-invalid-password-reset).
- **(b) The finance federation path.**
  - `src/admin/federation/finance-admin.client.ts:166-167` logs `path=${path}` on every degraded outcome. The comment says "no PII; URL path only".
  - The paths at `:65`, `:73` and `:93` embed `encodeURIComponent(email)`.
  - This is the same practice-type call whose caller line (`practice-type.service.ts:107`) this PR moved off the coach email. `redactEmailAddresses` would not catch `%40` either.
  - The Sol lens reported this first (its C-700-1); I verified it with my own probe. I grade it B here because it is the flow this PR fixed and the guard claims every log call.
- **Probe:** run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37219384148 (branch `audit/AUD-OPUS-FU2-118/700-all`; head `b5df58cb` = this head + 3 probe specs + lane files). 4 failed and 10 passed; `no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts` PASSES in the same run.
  - `aud-opus-fu2-118-reset-email-probe.spec.ts` received: `resetPasswordForEmail failed: Email address "pat.client+tgp@example.com" is invalid`.
  - `aud-opus-fu2-118-finance-path-probe.spec.ts` received: `Finance federation degraded path=/api/admin/federation/coaches/by-email/pat.client%2Btgp%40example.com/practice reason=http_error`.
  - The coach-name probe of B-700-1 fails again in this run.
- **Fix rule:**
  1. Pass Supabase Auth error text from every auth call that carries an address and logs `error.message` through `redactEmailAddresses` (at least `:1474` and `:879`).
  2. Log a fixed route label in the finance client (e.g. `route=coaches/by-email/practice`), never the path.
  3. Add both cases to `no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts`, and make the guard's email rule also flag a `path`/`url` built from an address (or ban `path=${path}` in that client).
  4. Make the README rule's scope true.
- **Verify:** both probe specs pass.

## C (optional)
- **C-700-1 (outside this diff): owner free text in a structured log.**
  - `src/ai-credits/coach-ai-budget.service.ts:425` and `:477` log `reason: args.reason`, the grant or refund reason the owner types.
  - `admin-coach-ai.controller.ts:94` says the reason is "persisted in the structured log", so the log is its only record. This is the same class as the TM note.
  - Fix rule: persist the reason on `CoachCreditPackPurchase` (additive migration) and log `reason_length`. Operator decision.
- **C-700-2 (outside this diff; the builder disclosed it): raw Prisma and Supabase exception text in catch blocks.**
  - Examples: `auth.service.ts:897,1215,2030`, `users/gdpr-scrub.service.ts:175`, `users/account.service.ts:113`.
  - Fix rule: add one shared redacting `errorMessageForLog()`, plus a guard rule that every bare `.message` interpolation goes through it.
- **C-700-3: `redactEmailAddresses` removes addresses only.**
  - A display name ("Name <address>") or other echoed field text survives: `log-pii.spec.ts` pins `to: <Pat Quill <[email]>>`.
  - No caller sends display-name recipients today. Resend, SendGrid and Postmark validation errors echo the address, not the subject or body. So this is optional hardening.
  - Fix rule: for provider failures, log and store the provider, HTTP status and the provider's error code/name, rather than body text.
- **C-700-4 (outside this diff; the builder disclosed it): health-adjacent values in log lines.**
  - `macros/macros.service.ts:95-96` logs a client's kcal target.
  - `ai/coach/coach-ai.service.ts:413-414` logs a client's daily calories against the target.
  - Fix rule: log ids and a drift band only.

- **C-700-5: `payloadShape` limits event and key strings to a character class, not a list of known names.**
  - Real Zoom and Google payloads never put a value in a key or the event name. Only a crafted request to the unauthenticated stub (when `SCHEDULING_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset) can put a name there.
  - Fix rule: log only known event names and keys; map anything else to `other` (`scheduling-webhook.controller.ts:95-108`).
